en: n. one of the nine parts of a baseball game in which each team bats once; a period of time when someone has a chance to do something; the period when a person or party holds power
ex: The home team scored three runs in the fifth inning.
主隊在第五局得了三分。

en: n. a particular way of doing something; a type or form of something; a setting on a machine or device; a style or fashion; (music) a scale or arrangement of notes
ex: Please switch your phone to silent mode during the meeting.
開會時請把手機切換成靜音模式。

en: n. a soft light substance full of holes that holds water well, used for washing; a simple sea animal with a soft body; a sweet cake; vt. to clean something with a sponge; to take money from someone without paying back; vi. to depend on others for money
ex: She wiped the table with a damp sponge.
她用濕海綿擦桌子。

en: a. (of clothes) old and torn; having an uneven or rough edge; looking untidy; (of a sound) rough and unpleasant
ex: The beggar wore ragged clothes and old shoes.
乞丐穿著破爛的衣服和舊鞋。

en: n. violent or angry behavior that is intended to hurt someone; an attack on another country; a feeling of anger that makes you want to attack someone
ex: The international community condemned the act of aggression.
國際社會譴責這項侵略行為。

en: vi. to become red in the face because of shame or embarrassment; to feel ashamed; vt. to cause something to turn pink or red; n. a red color on the face
ex: She blushed when everyone praised her.
大家稱讚她時，她臉紅了。

en: n. a short private road that leads from a public road to a house or garage; a place where a car is parked in front of a house
ex: He parked his car in the driveway.
他把車停在車道上。
ph: at the end of the driveway

en: n. one of the areas that some countries are divided into, with its own local government; a part of a country that is away from the capital; an area of knowledge or responsibility; (plural) all parts of a country except the capital
ex: Canada is divided into ten provinces and three territories.
加拿大分成十個省和三個地區。

en: a. relating to the system of rules by which a country is governed; allowed by a country's constitution; relating to a person's physical or mental condition; n. (old use) a short walk taken for health
ex: The court ruled that the law was not constitutional.
法院裁定這項法律違憲。

en: n. a sudden strong movement of air or wind; a violent explosion; a loud sound; vt. to destroy something with an explosion; to criticize someone angrily; vi. to explode; to play something very loudly
ex: The blast shook the windows of the nearby buildings.
爆炸震動了附近大樓的窗戶。

en: n. a person who uses their strength or power to hurt or frighten someone weaker; vt. to frighten or hurt someone weaker; to force someone to do something by threatening them; vi. to be a bully
ex: The older boy bullied the younger students at school.
那個大男孩在學校欺負年紀較小的學生。

en: a. certain to happen and impossible to avoid; that cannot be stopped; (of a result) happening in a way that you expect
ex: Change is inevitable in every field of life.
改變在生活的各個領域都是無可避免的。

en: n. a very large group of stars and planets held together by gravity; a group of very impressive or famous people; (the Galaxy) the Milky Way
ex: Our solar system is in the Milky Way galaxy.
我們的太陽系位於銀河系中。

en: a. likely to do something or suffer something; having a tendency to do something; lying flat with your face downward; (formal) willing
ex: Children are prone to catching colds in winter.
小孩在冬天容易感冒。

en: a. relating to a large company or business; shared by all members of a group; relating to a corporation; joint
ex: The company has a strong corporate culture.
這家公司有強烈的企業文化。

en: n. the way someone stands; an opinion or position on something; the way a person holds their feet when preparing to hit a ball; a way of standing, especially in sports
ex: The government took a firm stance against corruption.
政府對貪腐採取堅定的立場。

en: n. a person who is trained to help people with physical, mental or emotional problems; a person who provides treatment for illness or injury
ex: She sees a therapist every week to deal with her stress.
她每週看一次治療師來處理壓力。

en: n. the power or opportunity to act before others; a new plan to solve a problem; the quality of being able to act independently; a first step; a. relating to the first step
ex: He showed great initiative in solving the problem.
他在解決問題上表現出很強的主動性。

en: n. the period of time between two events; adv. during the time between two events; while something else is happening; for now
ex: In the meantime, please take a seat and wait.
在此期間，請坐下等候。

en: vt. to make use of something for a practical purpose; to use something effectively; to put something to good use
ex: The company utilizes solar energy to power its factory.
公司利用太陽能為工廠供電。

en: vi. (of a plant) to become dry and weak and start to die; to become weak or less; vt. to cause a plant to become dry; to make someone feel less confident
ex: The flowers withered because nobody watered them.
花因為沒人澆水而枯萎了。

en: n. something valuable that a person or company owns; a useful or valuable quality or skill; a person or thing that is useful; (plural) the things a company owns that have value
ex: Good communication skills are a great asset in this job.
良好的溝通技巧在這份工作上是一項很大的資產。

en: n. a large sea fish that is eaten as food; the meat of this fish, often sold in cans; a fish in the mackerel family
ex: She made a sandwich with canned tuna.
她用罐頭鮪魚做了三明治。

en: a. slightly fat in a pleasant and healthy way; round and soft, especially of a child or someone's face
ex: The baby has chubby cheeks and a big smile.
那嬰兒有圓圓的臉頰和大大的笑容。

en: n. a case in a court of law in which a person asks for a decision against another person or organization; the legal process of taking someone to court; a claim made by one person against another
ex: He filed a lawsuit against the company for unfair dismissal.
他對公司提起不當解僱的訴訟。

en: n. a particular part of an area of activity, especially of a country's economy; a part of a circle between two straight lines from the center to the edge; a part of an area controlled by the military; vt. to divide something into sectors
ex: The banking sector is expected to grow next year.
銀行業預期明年會成長。

en: n. the outside part of something; the outer appearance of a person or building; a. on the outside; relating to the outer surface of something
ex: The exterior of the building is covered with glass.
大樓的外觀覆蓋著玻璃。

en: n. a subject or skill that someone knows a lot about; a product that a place is famous for; a particular kind of product or service; a. unusual and special
ex: Seafood is the specialty of this restaurant.
海鮮是這家餐廳的招牌。

en: vt. to cancel the effect of something; to open something that has been fastened; to destroy someone's success or happiness; vi. to become untied
ex: Click the button to undo your last action.
按下按鈕即可還原你的上一個動作。

en: n. one of the parts into which something can be divided; a section of a population; a section of an orange or other fruit; v. to divide something into parts
ex: Each segment of the program lasts about ten minutes.
節目的每個單元大約持續十分鐘。

en: vt. to break the connection between two things; to cut off a telephone or electrical supply; to separate something from something else; vi. to lose a connection
ex: Please disconnect the power before you clean the machine.
清理機器前請先切斷電源。

en: vt. to make something dirty or harmful by adding a substance to it; to infect something with germs; to spoil something; to make something impure
ex: Factory waste has contaminated the river water.
工廠廢棄物污染了河水。

en: n. very great pain or suffering; a person or thing that causes great suffering; vt. to cause someone great pain; to annoy someone continually; to torture someone
ex: She suffered in torment after her loss.
失去親人後，她陷入痛苦折磨。

en: a. having strong muscles; relating to muscles; (of a person) strong and well built; having a powerful body
ex: The athlete has a muscular build from years of training.
那位運動員經過多年訓練，體格結實。

en: a. not concerned with or affected by something; not caring about something; adv. despite everything; in spite of the situation
ex: Everyone is welcome regardless of age or background.
無論年齡或背景，人人都歡迎。

en: n. a situation that makes something more difficult or complicated; a medical problem that develops as a result of an illness; a new problem that makes things harder; the state of being complicated
ex: The surgery led to some serious complications.
手術引發了一些嚴重的併發症。

en: n. a strong desire for more money, power or food than you need; a very strong wish to have more of something; excessive wanting
ex: His greed for money destroyed his friendships.
他對金錢的貪婪毀掉了他的友誼。

en: vi. to cry noisily with short, sudden breaths; vt. to say something while crying; to cry out; n. a short, sudden breath when crying
ex: The little girl sobbed when she lost her toy.
小女孩弄丟玩具時啜泣了起來。

en: n. a line that stays the same distance from another line along its whole length; a similarity or comparison between things; a similar or equal thing; a. going in the same direction and always at the same distance apart; similar and happening at the same time
ex: The two roads run parallel to each other.
這兩條路彼此平行。

en: n. a large farm, especially in North America, where cattle, horses or sheep are raised; a very large farm in the western United States; a type of house with one floor; v. to run a ranch or to raise animals on a ranch
ex: They own a cattle ranch in Texas.
他們在德州擁有一座牧牛場。
